<pasted_content id="82c9">
Small polish pass on public/style.css (and index.html/app.js only if needed). No libraries, keep all features and the current look.

1. End screen: put the left side (score, badge message, Back to modes button) inside a card that matches the other cards. Show the earned badge emoji large at the top of the card (or a hook emoji if no badge). Make it the same height as the right column and center its content vertically.
2. Make the mission screen use the same max width and left/right edges as the play screen, so both line up with the header logo.
3. On screens wider than 1600px, scale the base font size up slightly (use clamp, about 16px to 18px) so content fills larger monitors better. Phone layout stays the same.

Check at 1366x768, 1920x1080, and 375px phone width. Commit with "Polish end screen and align widths" and push to the same branch.
</pasted_content id="82c9">
